MerCruiser sterndrive and inboard repair in Tampa Bay

MerCruiser sterndrives power most of the runabouts and cruisers in Tampa Bay slips. Salt water is hard on them. Mechanics in the network handle drive service, bellows, manifolds and risers, and the engine itself.

Models we see most

Alpha One and Bravo drives, 3.0 through 8.2 gas inboards, MPI and carbureted

Service intervals

Annual engine service; drive oil annually; bellows every 2 to 3 years; manifolds and risers inspected annually and typically replaced every 5 to 7 years in salt water.

Parts and diagnostics

Excellent availability. Mechanics carry common drive seals, impellers, and gaskets.

What goes wrong on MerCruisers around here

  • Manifold and riser corrosion: water in cylinders if ignored
  • Bellows failure: water in the bilge and gimbal bearing damage
  • Raw-water pump impellers
  • Shift cable and interrupter adjustment
  • Trim sender and pump issues

Services for MerCruiser

Inboard and sterndrive$500 to $1,200 for annual serviceElectrical and batteries$150 to $700 for most diagnostics and repairs

Questions we get

How do I know my manifolds are due?

Age, rust weeping at the joints, and the mechanic's inspection. Catching it on the slip is routine; missing it is a new engine.
